TRIBUTE_SUMMON_SELECT: Select {Amount:plural:a monster on the field|[blue]{}[/blue] monsters on the field} to sacrifice as tribute.
RITUAL_SUMMON_PICK_TARGET: Select the [gold]Ritual Monster[/gold] to Ritual Summon from your hand.
RITUAL_SUMMON_MATERIALS_AT_LEAST: Select 1 to {Amount} monsters from your hand and/or field. Total level must be at least [blue]{Requirement}[/blue].
RITUAL_SUMMON_MATERIALS_EXACT: Select 1 to {Amount} monsters from your hand and/or field. Total level must be exactly [blue]{Requirement}[/blue].
FUSION_SUMMON_PICK_TARGET: Select the [gold]Fusion Monster[/gold] to Fusion Summon from your Extra Deck.
FUSION_SUMMON_PICK_MATERIALS: Select exactly [blue]{Count}[/blue] monster(s) from your hand and/or field as Fusion Materials.
THUNDER_DRAGON_HAND_EFFECT_SELECT: Select 1 or 2 [gold]Thunder Dragon[/gold] from your draw and discard piles to add to your hand.
DARK_SPIRIT_PICK_DOUBLE_HIT: Choose a different enemy with an attack intent (that enemy will attack twice).
BURST_STREAM_PICK_BLUE_EYES: Select a [gold]Blue-Eyes White Dragon[/gold] on your field.
DIFFUSION_WAVE_PICK_SPELLCASTER: Select a Level 7+ [gold]Spellcaster[/gold] on your field.
YGODUELIST-NEOW_STARTER_GRID.prompt: Build your starter deck: choose at least [blue]{MinCount}[/blue] and up to [blue]{MaxCount}[/blue] cards from the grid (18 random starter cards) to add to your deck before Neow's blessing.
YGODUELIST-PACK_REWARD_DECK.prompt: Pack opened: choose cards to add to your deck (0–[blue]{MaxCount}[/blue]). Cancel returns to pack choice.
YGODUELIST-PACK_REWARD_SIDE.prompt: Choose cards for your side deck from the rest (0–[blue]{MaxCount}[/blue]). Cancel returns to deck selection.
YGODUELIST-CAMPFIRE_DECK_ROW.label: YGO deck edits: [blue]{Count}[/blue] remaining (usable even after your main campfire action).
YGODUELIST-CAMPFIRE_DECK_REMOVE.prompt: Remove a YGO card from your deck (bonus campfire edit).
YGODUELIST-CAMPFIRE_DECK_ADD.prompt: Add a YGO card to your deck from trunk, side, or your unlocked pool (respects max deck size).
YGODUELIST-CAMPFIRE_DECK_REPLACE.pick_ol: Replace a YGO deck card — choose the card to remove.
YGODUELIST-CAMPFIRE_DECK_REPLACE.pick_ne: Choose the replacement (trunk, side, or unlocked pool).
OMINOUS_FORTUNETELLING_GUESS_PROMPT: Guess the type of the top card of your draw pile.
